description: rush-spec's Inputs section requires running validate-integration-map.sh before writing and stopping if it exits 1 ('the map must be fixed first, because a spec written against a broken map inherits the break'). Also guards Guardrail 9: a consumed interface with no provider must be reported, never invented. This case proves the gate itself fires on a map with a consume_without_provider gap.

given.scenario: Fixture specs/integration-map.md where feature 003-checkout consumes 'POST /payments/charge' with no 'from' provider declared — exactly the situation rush-spec must report rather than invent a provider for.
